name: Painted footprints to the bins
description: Bright lime footprints leading from the busiest seating area to the nearest bins.
hypothesis: Visual nudges from the seating area to the bins will raise disposal rates and cut litter accumulation in the south plaza.

interventions.name: Baseline (no paint)
interventions.description: The square as-is, before any footprints were painted.

interventions.name: Painted footprints
interventions.description: Lime footprints painted on the pavement from the south seating area to the nearest bins.

name: Cigarette voting ashtrays
description: Two transparent voting ashtrays at the south entrance posing a light-hearted question.
hypothesis: Gamified ashtrays convert discarded butts into a playful vote and reduce butts on the ground.

interventions.name: Voting ashtrays
interventions.description: Transparent two-column ashtrays with a weekly question.

name: Summer evening cleaning shift
description: Extending Friday and Saturday cleaning to 22:00 during the summer high-traffic season.
hypothesis: Later-evening cleaning during summer keeps Saturday/Sunday-morning litter visible to early visitors low.

interventions.name: Baseline (current schedule)
interventions.description: Cleaning ends at 19:00 Friday and Saturday.

interventions.name: Late-evening cleaning
interventions.description: Extend Friday and Saturday cleaning to 22:00 through June, July and August.

name: Saturday citizen sweep
description: Volunteer-led 30-minute citizen sweep every Saturday at 10:00, supported by the city.

name: Signage rewrite at north gate
description: Replacing the prohibitive 'no littering' sign with a humorous, gratitude-framed message.
hypothesis: A gratitude-framed sign reduces litter in the north entrance area more than a prohibitive one.

interventions.name: Gratitude sign
interventions.description: Illustrated sign thanking visitors for keeping the square tidy.

decision.summary: Consistent ~10% reduction across the north gate with no observed downsides. The effect is modest but durable; roll the gratitude-sign template out to the south and east entrances.
decision.nextStep: Roll the gratitude-sign template out to the south and east entrances in Q3.

name: Extra bins at night
description: Two additional bins placed near the seating area for the late-evening period.

interventions.name: Extra night bins
interventions.description: Two extra bins near the seating area, evenings only.

decision.summary: No measurable change in litter counts; the extra bins were under-used and added a servicing cost. Discontinue.
decision.nextStep: Reallocate the two bins to the Saturday market instead.
